subject_names.value: Eaton Vance Short Duration Diversified Income Fund
subject_names.span: This Tender Offer Statement on Schedule TO is filed by Eaton Vance Short Duration Diversified Income Fund, a Massachusetts business trust

subject_tickers.span: The Shares are traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “EVG.”

security_class.span: offer to purchase for cash up to 25% or 4,470,149 shares of its outstanding common shares

price_basis.span: The purchase price will equal 99% of the Fund’s net asset value (“NAV”) per Share as of the close of regular trading on the New York Stock Exchange (the “NYSE”) on the date the Offer expires

price_pct_nav.span: The purchase price will equal 99% of the Fund’s net asset value (“NAV”) per Share

nav_pricing_date.span: as of the close of regular trading on the New York Stock Exchange (the “NYSE”) on the date the Offer expires, July 30, 2021 (or if the Offer is extended, on the date to which the Offer is extended)

size_shares.span: a cash tender offer to purchase up to 25% or 4,470,149 (the “Offer Amount”)

commencement_date.span: June 29, 2021 — Eaton Vance Short Duration Diversified Income Fund (NYSE: EVG), Eaton Vance Floating-Rate Income Trust (NYSE: EFT), Eaton Vance Senior Floating-Rate Trust (NYSE: EFR) and Eaton Vance Senior Income Trust (NYSE: EVF) (each, a “Fund” and collectively, the “Funds”) each announced today the commencement of a cash tender offer

expiration_date.span: The Offer expires on July 30, 2021 at 5:00 p.m., Eastern Time, unless the Fund extends the Offer.

proration.span: If more Shares than the Offer Amount are properly tendered and not withdrawn prior to the date the Offer expires, the Fund will purchase the Offer Amount on a pro rata basis (disregarding fractional shares).

trigger_origin.span: In connection with the Transaction, Fund shareholders were asked to approve a new investment advisory agreement with EVM (the “New Agreement”) in order to maintain the continuity of the Fund’s operations. As announced on March 9, 2021, the Board approved the Offer, conditioned on Fund shareholders approving the New Agreement.

notes: trigger_origin: the Board approved the Offer on March 9, 2021, conditioned on shareholders approving a new advisory agreement that was needed because Morgan Stanley acquired Eaton Vance Corp. (the adviser's parent) on March 1, 2021 (the 'Transaction'); shareholders approved it on May 7, 2021. The merger is at the adviser's parent, not the fund, so merger_related is a judgement call (alternative: other). The stated purposes are partial liquidity near NAV and a possible temporary narrowing of the discount. commencement_date comes from the June 29, 2021 press release (exhibit seq 7); the Offer to Purchase is also dated June 29, 2021, and the summary says August 25, 2021 is 40 business days from commencement. That press release's boilerplate also says 'The Funds have not commenced the Tender Offers described in this release', which contradicts its first paragraph. Shares outstanding: 17,880,596 as of June 23, 2021. Inconsistency inside the Offer to Purchase: the Summary gives NAV $13.6727 and closing price $13.24 on June 23, 2021, while the Introduction calls $13.24 the NAV. Other conditions not listed separately: banking moratorium and credit limitations (market_disruption). The Offer is not conditioned on a minimum tender. Financing: the Fund expects to borrow part of the cost under its State Street credit agreement (not stated as a condition). The same press release covers concurrent tenders by EFT (up to 50%), EFR (up to 50%) and EVF (up to 60%), each at 99% of NAV expiring July 30, 2021. It also repeats a previously announced conditional tender programme for EFT, EFR and EVF: by the end of Q4 of each of 2022, 2023 and 2024, a tender for up to 10% of shares at 98% of NAV if the shares trade at an average discount above 10% (VWAP-based) from January to August of that year. Those funds are not this filing's subject, so they are not extracted as events here.
